senses.gloss:
Huttari Habba
(‘harvest festival’)
------------------------------------------
This is a local festival observed only in the Koḍagu or Coorg district of Karnataka State.
The Koḍavas or the coorgis are a martial race. This is their harvest festival, celebrated on the pūrṇimā day of Mārgaśira, associated with the नक्षत्र or constellation रोहिणी. It is generally spread over a week. Worship of the paddy fields, bathing the ears of corn with milk and honey before harvesting them, firing in the air to express their joy, decorations of temples and houses, offering the new rice to God and partaking of it, apart from the wearing of new clothes, मुसिच् and regional dances which are usual on such occasions—these are the main features of this festival.
